audit.whatIsWrong: Ionian Fervor is described five times as armour shred, and Defiant Dance is credited with healing.
audit.why: Riot text: Ionian Fervor stacks bonus attack speed off spell hits and adds on-hit damage at max stacks — no shred at all. Defiant Dance charges a strike and reduces PHYSICAL damage taken during the charge; it heals nothing. The healing is Bladesurge (10/9/8/7/6s, refreshes on a Marked target or a kill), which is also why Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and Vanguard's Edge leaves a wall you have no dash to cross.

edits.after: This is where it slips. Your Level 6 Depth Charge is undodgeable, but Irelia answers it — Flawless Duet stuns you mid-lock, Defiant Dance cuts the physical damage of your burst, and Bladesurge heals her as she resets back onto you. You dont have the raw damage to kill her inside one R, and Ionian Fervor's on-hit eats your tank stats. Hold R for a gank or a kill setup; dont waste it as a solo engage she survives and turns around.

notes: The 'passive shred' fiction the mirror found on this champion is present here too and was load-bearing in whys[3], spikes[2] and mid. Ionian Fervor grants attack speed and on-hit damage, not armour reduction. Defiant Dance also does not heal — Bladesurge does.
